patch_description: Wrap the greedy + local-search pipeline in a Las Vegas restart loop (30 iterations) with random jitter: shuffle the model order within the greedy phase (instead of a fixed density sort) and use a random tie-break among near-equal GPUs. Each candidate is refined by the existing move/swap local search, and the best (lowest max KVPR) placement is retained. This exploits first-fit's order sensitivity at negligible runtime cost.
